base-map.forbidden: The Base Treasure Map cannot be used with this adventure board. Choose another Treasure Map.
option.board.5: In the jaws of the Kraken
option.board.8.help: Features TWO Treasure Maps: the one you chose, plus a second one drawn at random at the start of the game.
option.board.help: Choose which adventure board all players will use for this game. Each board offers a different layout of spaces and effects.
option.treasureMap.1.help: If you have the Treasure Map at the end of your turn, take 1 coin.
option.treasureMap.2.help: You CANNOT flip any tiles. Take 2 coins at the end of your turn.
option.treasureMap.3.help: You have a Bomb. It counts for the Gunner effect and end-of-game. Take 1 coin at the end of your turn. End of game: take 5 coins.
option.treasureMap.4.help: If you gained no coins during this turn, take 2 coins.
option.treasureMap.5.help: At the end of your turn, steal 1 coin from the richest player. If you are strictly the richest, steal nothing.
option.treasureMap.6.help: When you take this card, place it with North facing up. At the end of each turn, take the indicated coins (1, 2, 1, then 3) and rotate the card a quarter turn clockwise.
option.treasureMap.help: Choose which Treasure Map variant will be used during the game. The Base Map is free; other variants are subscriber only and bring unique twists. On the Observatory board, a second random Treasure Map is added on top of your choice.
